summary: Warps a source TOP using a displacement image, with channel source, midpoint, weight, UV, offset, and extend controls.

key_params.name: resolutionsource
key_params.note: Output resolution source: source or displace image

key_params.name: uvweight
key_params.note: Weight between UV-relative and offset-anchored displacement

key_params.name: extend
key_params.note: Out-of-bounds sampling: hold, zero, repeat, or mirror

common_gotchas: Black and white displacement maps are not neutral; 0.5 is neutral by default.
The documented green/vertical direction can feel inverted relative to screen-space expectations.
UV Weight 0 anchors displacement around the Offset point.
Aspect correction matters on non-square or ultrawide textures.
key_concepts: Displace TOP uses the first input as the source image and the second input as the displacement image.
Red, green, blue, alpha, or none can drive horizontal, vertical, and Z displacement sources.
The neutral displacement midpoint is 0.5 by default, not black or white.
Displace Weight scales the warp independently across axes.
UV Weight changes whether displacement is relative to output UVs or anchored around the offset point.
The official TOP supports 3D textures and 2D texture arrays.
